syncingTab.intro: Every outside system kept in step with Provisa: data catalogs, ontologies and systems of your own. Each says which way it syncs. Descriptions, owners, tags and terms are kept in step, not data.
syncingTab.duplicateCredentialsNote: The credentials of {{id}} are not copied: enter them here.
syncingTab.name: Name
syncingTab.nameHelp: A short name, unique in the organization (for example openmetadata-prod). Two data catalogs may be of the same kind.
syncingTab.typeHelp: A data catalog Provisa can reach directly, an ontology, or a system of your own.
syncingTab.directionHelp: Export sends from Provisa to the system; Import brings from the system to Provisa. A direction that is off never runs.
syncingTab.domainsHelp: The domains that work with it. Their tables and data products are sent to it, and their tables offer it.
syncingTab.gcpProjectHelp: The project the data products are created in.
syncingTab.gcpLocationHelp: The Dataplex location, such as us or europe-west1.
syncingTab.awsRegionHelp: The region of the DataZone domain, such as us-east-1.
syncingTab.datazoneDomainIdHelp: The domain the data products are published in.
syncingTab.secretHelp: Stored credentials are never displayed. Leave blank to keep the current one; clear and save to remove it.
syncingTab.roleHelp: The catalog is sent only what this role can read.
syncingTab.datazoneProjectIdHelp: The project that owns the data products and approves subscriptions.
syncingTab.deltaShare: Also publish each product as a Delta Share
syncingTab.deltaShareHelp: Other data teams receive the share once a Databricks admin grants it to their recipient. Only members stored in Delta can be shared.
syncingTab.reconcileCronHelp: Cron expression for the full publish to every entry that exports. Leave empty to publish on change only.
syncingTab.notEntitledTitle: Publishing is not included in this plan
syncingTab.notEntitled: Exporting requires the {{tier}} plan. Entries can still be kept for Import.
syncingTab.neverRun: Not published since the server started.
syncingTab.deleteConsequence: Provisa stops syncing with it. Nothing is removed from the system itself.
syncingTab.differencesHelp: Each value the catalog holds differently from Provisa. Accept takes one side for a row, or for a whole table or term.
syncingTab.diffNoDifferences: The catalog holds the same values as Provisa.
syncingTab.diffBothOff: Both directions are off, so no differences are listed.
syncingTab.diffExportOff: This entry does not export, so Provisa's value cannot be sent to the catalog.
syncingTab.diffImportOff: This entry does not import, so the catalog's value cannot be taken into Provisa.
syncingTab.diffKindNotImportable: Taking a catalog's owners, tags and glossary links into Provisa is not supported yet.
syncingTab.standingChoicesHelp: What a run does with each kind of difference, per direction. Hold, or no standing choice, leaves the difference here for a steward.
syncingTab.title: Context Sync
